period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone, Shariah-based Islamic bank ('Investments' not 'Loans and Advances'). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January (9-month cumulative), as published in the bank's own 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (3rd Quarter) ended 30 September 2022' -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix; the filing's own table ALSO prints a separate discrete 'July'22-Sept'22' column, captured here as the _discrete_quarter fields. Source PDF ('Un-audited_Quarterly_Statement_Q3_as_on_30th_September,_2022.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 30 October 2022' signature block) is a SCANNED IMAGE document -- independently OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) since pdftotext's own text layer was unusable. Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly: Total Liabilities (223,488,139,058) + Total Equity (15,095,199,897) = Total Assets (238,583,338,955). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (4,995,882,360) - Total Operating Expenses (2,421,108,880) = Profit before Provision and Tax (2,574,773,480); - Total Provisions (280,000,000) = Total Profit before Tax (2,294,773,480); - Tax (970,150,803) = Net Profit after Tax (1,324,622,677). Unlike 2022 Q2, this filing's own P&L page OCR'd cleanly enough to capture 'Investments Income' (14,280,099,040) and 'Profit Paid on Deposits' (-10,203,464,857) directly, which subtract to exactly reproduce Net Investment Income (4,076,634,183) -- an internal cross-check confirming OCR reliability. Discrete Q3-2022-alone figures (Profit before Tax 902,701,696; Net Profit after Tax 554,229,481; EPS 0.56) are directly OCR'd from the filing's own 'July'22-Sept'22' column and independently confirmed by subtraction against this dataset's own 2022_Q2.json cumulative figures (both matches exact). Notably, discrete quarterly provisioning for classified investments was slightly NEGATIVE in both Q2 2022 (-17.5m, a reversal) and Q3 2022 (-72.5m, a larger reversal) -- ordinary provisioning volatility in a still-healthy period, not a red flag; contrast with the sharp, sustained increases seen from 2024 Q2 onward (see that year's period_notes). This report's own December-2021 comparative balance-sheet column matches this dataset's stored FY2021 annual figures exactly -- no restatement. The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures.
